description: 15 frozen test pairs for 3-way ablation evaluation. Grounded in actual indexed documents. Frozen 2026-04-10 BEFORE any weight calibration.

types.cohort_specific: Query includes a cohort year (K20xx). Correct doc must cover that cohort. Tests cohort-aware reranking.
types.amendment_sensitive: Topic has a newer doc that amends an older one. Tests temporal scoring to prefer newer doc.
types.general: No cohort or amendment constraint. Tests baseline retrieval quality. Control group.
